answer: Latency escrow registration. Each new identity must fund an escrow whose release requires 30 days of continuous uptime and active task participation, tracked by periodic signed heartbeats. Clones that go dormant forfeit escrow, so a tundra of idle accounts bleeds capital. Attackers also pay real compute and bandwidth per clone to sustain heartbeats across the registration inlet, and detection of correlated behavior triggers forfeiture across the whole canyon of linked accounts, making each marginal clone a guaranteed loss.
